title: GENERAL MAGIC - Official Trailer
channel: General Magic and the Soul of Tech
summary: The official trailer for the documentary General Magic, about the secretive Apple spinoff that tried to build a handheld communicator in 1990 and whose ideas shaped the smartphone era.
why: HN recommends the documentary itself as a story of an epic early failure in mobile computing, and the trailer is the linked entry point.

quote.text: Highly recommend the documentary on General Magic.
